title: Cloud fallback submits Batch only if unclaimed or stale
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Step Functions cloud fallback
  Scenario: Claimed job skips Batch
    Given a job claimed by the local worker before the wait ends
    When the fallback Choice runs
    Then Batch is not submitted
  Scenario: Unclaimed job submits Batch
    Given a still-pending job after the wait
    When the fallback Choice runs
    Then a Batch GPU job is submitted with a single-job token
```

## Implementation brief
1. CDK Step Functions + Batch + ECR as in stacks/backend.py.
2. worker-image runner redeems single-job token; no long-lived keys.
3. Lease heartbeat + reclaim path.
right_now_summary: The cloud fallback submits a Batch job only when the job remains unclaimed or becomes stale.
